instruction: Candid action photograph, medium close-up. Inside a minimalist indoor martial arts dojo, the older man with short grey hair (R3) on the left and the bearded young man (R4) on the right practice judo techniques. The older man (R3), wearing a white gi with a circular shoulder patch, stands in profile facing right, firmly grabbing the extended arm of the bearded young man (R4), who wears a white gi and faces left. The older man raises his other hand defensively with a focused expression. Bright, diffused indoor lighting illuminates the scene against a plain grey background.
